info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Campaign Review Submission API
info.description: The Customer Campaign Review Submission API allows businesses to collect and manage reviews related to customer campaigns. This endpoint enables users to submit reviews which can help enhance customer feedback and improve campaign effectiveness. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and customer service representatives who wish to analyze customer sentiments post-campaign. By utilizing this API, organizations can enrich their understanding of customer experiences and adapt future campaigns accordingly.

post.summary: Create a review for the customer campaign execution.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a review for the specified customer campaign execution, identified by CUST-100045. It enables users to provide feedback or additional information regarding the campaign's performance directly tied to the customer.

requestBody.description: Submit a new review for the specified customer campaign execution. This request should include all relevant details concerning the review being submitted.
